decisions.statement: The dump is divided into sections by its own headings.
A section heading the dump does not have leaves that section empty.
A documented type is answered as the matching TypeScript type.
A type the map does not name is answered unchanged.
Whether a type may be written into a declaration is answered here.
A type the map names, a name, and a name or nothing may be written.
Any other type is answered as a fault naming that type.
The names this reads come from outside the repository, in a clone nobody here updates.
A name is captured as a run of word characters, which admits a leading digit.
Whether a name may be written into a declaration is answered, as it is for a type.
An enum with no values is no enum.
An object states the object above rather than the objects below.

definition: the functions, objects, events and enums a game documentation dump describes
